text.q1: Three kilometres down, in the Arabian Sea, the photo is only light.
text.q2: Light in glass travels about 200,000 kilometres every second.
text.q3: As it fades, a repeater, every 60 to 100 kilometres, boosts it.
text.r1: At the next stop, a router reads the label. Each router only knows the next step.
text.r2: If a road is busy, it sends it another way.
text.r3: Then the land ends. The cable goes into the sea.
text.r4: From here, it all travels as light, under the sea.
